summary: PDF templates can place a form's computed variables as zones; PdfGeneratorService evaluates them per submission; 0/'0' now printed; PDF cache key includes computed-variable hash; zone field_id validation stricter.

statements.why: Signed download/preview routes unchanged; edit routes stay authenticated; no security/data-loss issue.

statements.text: The agent changed the open form PDF template submission download and open form PDF template preview parts of your server in ways plain can't describe yet.
statements.why: Both routes use PdfGeneratorService, which changed; unexplained.

statements.text: The agent also changed PdfRightSidebar.vue and working_pdf.js, in ways plain can't describe yet.
statements.why: Editor sidebar/store really changed to list and place computed variables.

misses.what: New feature: in the PDF editor you can add computed variables (formula results) to a PDF template, and generated PDFs fill them in per submission.
Fields whose answer is 0 (or '0') now appear in generated PDFs; before they were blank.
All previously cached PDFs are regenerated once; PDFs refresh when computed-variable formulas change.
Saving a PDF template now rejects zones whose field_id isn't a real field/special field/computed variable.
